# Vendored iPlug2

Generated by `scripts/vendor_iplug2.sh`, then patched as listed under Patches. Make no other edits:
`scripts/license_audit.py` checks every file against `MANIFEST.sha256`.

* iPlug2 commit: `de5a4fb14fd964247f0c70f2c90b32876a3bfc7c`
* VST3 SDK: VST 3.8.1 (MIT), separate download, subset pinned by SHA-256 `ccc801c4e5dbf28c01f3142d475bfb9c44360dc2b66abd1c8d8594845ae8abbf`
* Licences per path: `../LICENSES.json`; texts: `../licenses/` and the licence files in this tree

Left out on purpose: AAX, VST2, AUv3, WEB and ReaperExt wrappers; the ASIO headers of RtAudio; Extras
with other licences or such dependencies (HIIR/Oversampler, LanczosResampler/RealtimeResampler, NoiseGate,
OSC, Faust); IGraphics Extras, Skia and WebView; WDL beyond the include closure of the files below
(in particular swell/gtk* and resample.*); SDK logos.

## Patches

1. `IGraphics/Platforms/IGraphicsMac_view.h` and `IGraphicsMac_view.mm`: the number-only text entry formatter
   (`IGRAPHICS_FORMATTER`, its interface, implementation and one call site in `createTextEntry`) was replaced.
   Upstream credited it to a blog post that states no licence. The replacement is MIT, part of this project,
   and was written from the `NSFormatter` API without using the removed code: an allowed character set and a
   length limit, checked on each edit.

`scripts/vendor_iplug2.sh` applies them with `scripts/iplug2_patches/apply.py`, which holds the replacement text.
